Microsoft Store apps Windows 10 & 11 Audio & MIDI routing

Different by design

Not another custom virtual audio driver.

Virtual Cables approaches loopback audio from the USB side. The application exports standards-based USB audio devices locally; Windows discovers them and uses its built-in USB audio class driver.

01

Your source app

Sends audio to the playback side of a selected Virtual Cable.

02

Virtual Cables

Routes samples through an independent in-memory buffer.

03

USB/IP transport

Presents each cable as a local virtual USB audio device.

04

Your destination app

Receives the stream from the matching recording endpoint.

Built for flexible routing

One compact app. A lot of cable.

32

Independent virtual cables

Each cable has its own playback endpoint, recording endpoint, USB identity and audio buffer.

↔

Direct loopback

Standards-based

Microsoft Store collection

Virtual audio and MIDI cable apps for Windows.

Get the primary cable applications directly from Microsoft Store. Store installation provides a familiar Windows download and update experience.

Microsoft Store · Driverless Hi-Fi audio

Virtual Driverless Hi-Fi Cable

Hi-Fi

Virtual Driverless Hi-Fi Cable is a Windows audio-routing app for creating a compatible virtual Hi-Fi connection without distributing a separate custom audio driver. It is designed for recording, streaming, audio transfer and software-to-software routing workflows.

Open Store page

Microsoft Store · Driverless MIDI routing

Virtual Driverless MIDI Cables

MIDI

Virtual Driverless MIDI Cables connects compatible Windows music applications through virtual MIDI paths. Use it with sequencers, software instruments, controllers, MIDI utilities and development or testing tools.

Open Store page

Microsoft Store · DAC audio routing

Virtual Cables from DAC

DAC

Virtual Cables from DAC uses supported DAC-based audio paths for Windows routing scenarios. It provides another way to connect playback and recording workflows through compatible audio hardware and applications.

Open Store page

Requirements

Made for modern Windows.

A signed USB/IP transport is required to connect the locally exported USB audio devices to Windows.

  • Operating systemWindows 10 or Windows 11
  • Architecturex64
  • Audio format48,000 Hz · stereo · 16-bit PCM
  • Transportusbip-win2
  • Cable count1–32
Administrator approval may be requested when the USB/IP transport is installed or the virtual USB devices are attached.

Virtual Cables

A new path between playback and recording.

Choose a cable as the output in one application and the matching cable as the input in another. The signal stays on your computer.
